adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
adds.text: Trip slips a phone into Glenn Talbot's pocket so Coulson can warn him that Creel is coming for him, but Talbot refuses the help and vows to lock Coulson up.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The general Trip slips a phone to so Coulson can warn him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who slips Talbot a phone ahead of Creel's attack.
adds.evidence: AoS S2#1 'Shadows': a stranger (Triplett) bumps into Talbot at Potomac Plaza and plants a phone in his pocket; Coulson calls to warn him of the Absorbing Man; Talbot refuses and snaps the phone.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#7
adds.text: Trip tracks the escaped Ward to a bus depot, but backs off and lets him board a bus when Ward quietly shows him the explosives strapped to his body.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A traitor who shows Trip his explosives and slips away.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who lets Ward go when he shows his explosives.
adds.evidence: AoS S2#7 'The Writing on the Wall': Ward, strapped with explosives at a Philadelphia bus station, subtly reveals them to Triplett, who lets him take a bus to Atlanta.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#8
adds.text: When Trip is shot and Calvin Zabo cuts one of his veins, Fitz and Coulson follow Zabo's directions to keep him from bleeding to death.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who helps save Trip from bleeding to death.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Fitz helps save from bleeding to death.
adds.evidence: AoS S2#8 'The Things We Bury': Triplett is shot at Laura Creek; Cal Zabo severs a vein and then shows Fitz and Coulson how to save him.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#10
adds.text: Trip and May fly the Bus together to escape four Hydra Quinjets, then pursue Ward to San Juan.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who flies the Bus with Trip to escape Hydra's jets.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who flies the Bus with May to escape Hydra's jets.
adds.evidence: AoS S2#10 'What They Become': Triplett and May combine their piloting skills to evade the attack of four Hydra Quinjets as the Bus cloaks, then go to San Juan.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#9
adds.text: Skye comes to the Vancouver safe house where Billy Koenig is guarding Raina and mistakes him for his brother Sam. When Agent 33 ambushes them, she holds Agent 33 off while Billy gets Raina out.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who holds off Agent 33 while Billy gets Raina out.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who gets Raina out while Daisy fights Agent 33.
adds.evidence: AoS S2#9 '...Ye Who Enter Here': Skye collects Raina and Billy from the safe house, mistakes him for Sam, then fights Agent 33 and orders Billy to take Raina to the stairs.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
adds.text: Billy Koenig coaches Coulson on Glenn Talbot's tone and phrasing while Coulson fakes Talbot's voice to get his team into the military warehouse.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's Director, whom he coaches on faking Talbot's voice.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who coaches Coulson on faking Talbot's voice.
adds.evidence: AoS S2#1 'Shadows': Coulson uses a scan of Talbot's voice to phone the warehouse guard, with Koenig advising him on how to mimic Talbot's tone and phrasing, while they monitor the infiltration.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
adds.text: Skye helps bring down Carl Creel with a taser launcher when he attacks Glenn Talbot, then watches as Coulson questions the kidnapped general aboard the Bus.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A general Daisy saves from Creel, then helps kidnap.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who saves Talbot from Creel, then helps kidnap him.
adds.evidence: AoS S2#1 'Shadows': as May fights Creel, Skye immobilizes him with a Taser Projectile Launcher, saving Talbot; after the team kidnaps Talbot, Skye watches Coulson question him.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#11
adds.text: Jemma shows Skye how Raina's DNA has changed and calls people with powers a plague, so Skye, who has changed too, keeps it from her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who calls people with powers a plague, unaware Daisy has changed.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who hides her new powers from Jemma.
adds.evidence: AoS S2#11 'Aftershocks': Simmons shows Skye Raina's altered DNA and harshly refers to those with powers as a plague, worrying Skye, who has changed; Fitz covers for Skye.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#21
adds.text: When May refuses to leave Afterlife after the shooting, Skye fights her and knocks her out with her powers.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's trainer, whom she knocks out in Afterlife.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: May's trainee, who knocks her out in Afterlife.
adds.evidence: AoS S2#21 'S.O.S. Part One': Skye confronts May, who is looking for Gonzales; when May refuses to leave Afterlife, they fight and Skye knocks May out with her powers (May forgives her in S2#22).

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#19
adds.text: Skye finds Mike Peterson tortured in a Hydra cell during the raid on List's base, and he sends her on to save Lincoln.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Daisy finds tortured in a Hydra cell.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who finds Mike in a Hydra cell.
adds.evidence: AoS S2#19 'The Dirty Half Dozen': Peterson is found in his cell by Coulson's team including Skye and Simmons; he sends Skye to save Lincoln Campbell.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#14
adds.text: Coulson pulls Skye from active duty and takes her to a safe house, asking her to take time to learn to control her powers.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's recruiter, who takes her to a safe house to learn control.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's recruit, whom he sends away to learn control.
adds.evidence: AoS S2#14 'Love in the Time of Hydra': on Garner's recommendation, Coulson pulls Skye from active duty and leaves her at a safe house with gloves, asking her to learn to control her powers.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
adds.text: Dugan and Peggy Carter raid Hydra's last known base, arrest Werner Reinhardt and lock away the strange things they find there.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend who raids Hydra's last base with Dugan.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who raids Hydra's last base with Peggy.
adds.evidence: AoS S2#1 'Shadows' (1945 opening): Dugan, Carter and Morita capture the last known Hydra base in Austria, Dugan handcuffs Reinhardt, and they lock away the artifacts while Dugan asks Carter what they are.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15
adds.text: After Gonzales' faction takes the Playground, Fitz is surprised to find Weaver alive. She tells him and Jemma how she survived Hydra and that Coulson has no right to call his group S.H.I.E.L.D.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Weaver's former student, surprised to find her alive.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's old teacher, now in a rival S.H.I.E.L.D.
adds.evidence: AoS S2#15 'One Door Closes': Weaver speaks to Fitz and Simmons, who are surprised to see her alive; she explains her survival and says Coulson has no right to call his organization S.H.I.E.L.D.
